data.user_prompt: Which custom firmware is available for Whatsminer M30, M50 and M60 miners? List specific vendors.

sections.text:
Here is an overview of the custom (third-party) firmware options available for **Whatsminer M30, M50, and M60** series miners, along with specific vendors:
